verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll/HR SaaS platform, so official SDKs are a fair question, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions an SDK, client library, or developer API. The help-center content covers only UI workflows and a Xero accounting integration, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
